primary_documentation.design_consequence: Add an IPC namespace for those resources, but do not treat that flag as isolating filesystem-backed semaphore names.
primary_documentation.fact: IPC namespaces isolate System V IPC and POSIX message queues, rather than all pathname-named IPC. Namespace destruction clears its namespace-scoped objects.

primary_documentation.design_consequence: Private filesystem backing is needed as well as namespace isolation; process exit alone does not establish name removal.
primary_documentation.fact: Linux POSIX named semaphores normally have filesystem names under /dev/shm; applications close them and unlink their names.

primary_documentation.design_consequence: Create and bind the private shm directory before making the recreated /dev mount read-only, and verify both mount permissions at runtime.
primary_documentation.fact: --unshare-ipc creates a new IPC namespace. --remount-ro changes only the specified mount point and does not change nested mount points.
